school: 库萨哲学 / 德国神秘主义 / 文艺复兴早期人文主义
historical_significance: 库萨的尼古拉（Nicholas of Cusa, Nikolaus von Kues）是中世纪晚期向近代过渡的关键思想家：枢机主教、外交家、法学家与数学家。他以《论有学问的无知》提出'有学问的无知'（docta ignorantia）与'对立面的一致'（coincidentia oppositorum），把否定神学、数学推理与新柏拉图主义熔为一炉；在《论天主教的和谐》中系统论述教会会议至上主义与同意政治，在《论信仰的和平》中设想诸宗教在共同理性下和平共存。他的无限宇宙观（宇宙没有中心、没有边界）先于哥白尼与布鲁诺，被称为'近代哲学第一人'之一。
historical_significance_en: Nicholas of Cusa (Nikolaus von Kues, 1401-1464) was a cardinal, diplomat, jurist and mathematician whose thought marks the pivot from late medieval to early modern philosophy. In De docta ignorantia he proposed 'learned ignorance' and 'the coincidence of opposites,' fusing negative theology, mathematical reasoning and Neoplatonism. In De concordantia catholica he systematically developed conciliarism and consent-based politics; in De pace fidei he envisioned peaceful coexistence of religions under a shared rationality. His infinite universe — a cosmos with neither center nor boundary — anticipated Copernicus and Bruno, earning him the title of a 'first philosopher of modernity.'
unique_thinking: 以'有学问的无知'处理超越性：承认理性在无限面前的必然失败，并把这个失败本身转化为方法；用数学（极大、极小、不可通约）作为攀登形而上问题的阶梯；把对立面的一致作为终极真理的结构；把视角（visio）与相对性制度化进认识论——每个视角都是真而不全的。
unique_thinking_en: Handling transcendence through 'learned ignorance': acknowledging that reason necessarily fails before the infinite, and converting that very failure into method. Using mathematics (maximum, minimum, incommensurability) as a ladder to metaphysical questions; taking the coincidence of opposites as the structure of ultimate truth; and institutionalizing perspective (visio) and relativity within epistemology — every perspective is true yet incomplete.
civilization_zh: 基督教欧洲（神圣罗马帝国/教廷，文艺复兴早期）
civilization_en: Christian Europe (Holy Roman Empire / Papal Curia, early Renaissance)
key_works: De docta ignorantia (论有学问的无知, 1440)
De concordantia catholica (论天主教的和谐, 1433)
De pace fidei (论信仰的和平, 1453)
De visione Dei (论上帝之视/论圣像, 1453)
key_concepts: 宇宙无中心 (universus non habet centrum)

cross_references.name: 黄宗羲
cross_references.note_zh: 黄宗羲以'工夫所至即是本体'落实认知于历史与制度实践；库萨以对立一致把认知推向无限之超越综合——一个内在化，一个超越化。
cross_references.note_en: Huang Zongxi grounds cognition in historical and institutional practice ('where the effort arrives, there is the noumenon'); Cusanus pushes cognition toward transcendent synthesis — internalization versus transcendence.

cross_references.name: 董仲舒
cross_references.note_zh: 董仲舒以天人感应构建有中心等级宇宙；库萨宣布宇宙无中心无边界——两种'宇宙秩序'论证方向相反。
cross_references.note_en: Dong Zhongshu builds a hierarchical, centered cosmos of heaven-human resonance; Cusanus declares a universe without center or boundary — opposite directions of cosmic-order argument.

cross_references.name: 莲花生
cross_references.note_zh: 两者都用'悖论/超越概念'作为觉悟的通道：莲花生以密教方便超越二元，库萨以对立一致超越知性对立。
cross_references.note_en: Both use paradox and concept-transcendence as the gateway to realization: Padmasambhava transcends duality through Vajrayana skillful means; Cusanus through the coincidence of opposites.
